why: PHASE 2D acceptance: the SAME deterministic engine must run unchanged on arbitrary books. Four unrelated domains, none named anywhere in executable code. A whitelist tuned to the I4 corpus would fail every one of these.

### Durable Messaging

A transactional outbox is a pattern that records outgoing events in the same database transaction as the state change. The write-ahead log is a file that records mutations before they are applied. The system was restarted twice. Teams often deploy a message broker alongside it.

### Respiratory Failure

Acute respiratory distress syndrome is a condition in which fluid collects in the alveoli. Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert light into chemical energy. The patient improved overnight. Clinicians monitored oxygen saturation closely.

### The Ashen Court

The Ember Rite is a ceremony performed at the turning of the year. Soulbinding refers to the joining of two fates by oath. Kaelen crossed the courtyard at dusk. The old bridge had stood for centuries.
